correctness.rationale: On the all-ones orthogonal complement, the complete-graph Laplacian acts as nI. The weighted clique Laplacians are aP_A and bP_B. Their one-dimensional overlapping directions have squared cosine (a-1)(b-1)/(ab), yielding the exact PGF. A nonnegative 2x2 Bernoulli table, coefficient extraction and telescope identities prove the signed law, negative upper quadrants, and TV formula; binomial mode Stirling gives the constant. Independent Prüfer enumeration n=3..7 passed 777 exact assertions. All positivity and boundary conditions are specified.

value.rationale: For an infinite and natural family of pairwise-overlapping induced subgraphs, this gives the complete joint count law, exact negative upper-tail dependence, and sharp TV independence error (including the leading macroscopic constant). These quantitative facts are absent from mere pairwise edge correlation and carry a structural one-pair explanation; both exact finite and asymptotic content are mathematically motivated.
